svg.desc: NOVA Industries Factory LOCATION 10th Of Ramadan, Egypt CLIENT CIB STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress ~ 280 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Design and implementation of an administrative building and a factory for the production of metal components for Waste Water Treatment Plants. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents and site supervision. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
